operations.title: Entry 1242 — The Five-Site Compatible Pair Landau Census Closes Without a New Divisor
operations.body: For each of the seven final four-focus representatives, all three exact staged second resultants are 1 over Q(z,t). Independent replications at p=1009 and 1021, both quadratic embeddings, give 84 modular unit results. The 49 pair orbits classify as 7 confined to t=0, 8 projecting to existing one-wall thresholds, and 34 with unit stationarity ideals. No new pair divisor occurs on the frozen cyclic family.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the complete five-site compatible pair Landau census
operations.body: Entry 1242 closes all 49 compatible pair orbits. The final seven four-focus ideals have exact staged second resultants (1,1,1) over Q(z,t), replicated at p=1009,1021 and both z embeddings. Classification: 7 confined to t=0, 8 old one-wall support, 34 unit stationarity ideals. No new pair divisor. Next I will eliminate triple classes inheriting G, repeated-cut, or unit-pair subideals before building genuine three-wall systems.
